title: PhysicsTest run matrix (physicstest.matrix/1)
description: Config/Matrices/<name>.json, read by Tools/ptbench (python -I -m ptbench run --matrix <name>; 03_WorkPlan M8, 02_Architecture 12.5). Cells = targets x profiles x scenes x threads minus the exclude rules; every repeat runs each cell once in a block shuffled with a seed derived from block_seed (docs/ResultsSchema.md 11).

purpose.description: perf: timing tables (R >= 5 is the protocol, 02 12.5; the report marks fewer). determinism: DET1 groups (fresh processes of one exe, same T), usually with -HashEvery=1 for the first divergent frame. behavior (M9): behaviour runs (-RunMode=Behavior with -StatesEvery: states.ptst + scene_desc.json) for analysis/behavior.py; their timings never enter a table. M11 (thread series) extends this enum.

preset.description: The build whose out/<preset>/bin/PhysicsTestBench.exe runs the matrix (headline timing: test or test-avx2). --exe / --preset override it.

cooldown_s.description: Wait before every run (02 12.5: 2 s); the system load during it is recorded.

timeout_s.description: A run that does not end in time is killed and recorded as timed_out (no exit.json).

contaminated_retries.description: Fresh-process retries of a run that ends with exit code 4 (default 2); the cell is 'contaminated' when every attempt ends with 4.

window.description: The scene window whose per-run mean is the run's value (default headline).

bench_args.description: Extra PhysicsTestBench switches for every run (e.g. -HashEvery=1 for a determinism matrix). ptbench refuses a switch key (case-insensitive, before '='; -ini: up to [Section]:Key) that appears twice for a cell over the matrix's, the target's, the scene's (M9) and --bench-arg switches - the bench reads the first occurrence only (FParse::Value) - and the switches the runner sets per cell (-Out, -Backend, -BackendProfile, -Profile, -Scenario, -Param:, -Threads, -Frames, -Repeat, -Order, -BlockSeed, -Session) or that start another mode (-Gate, -List, -Describe, -Conformance, -AnalyticReferences, -SceneHashes, -BusyHelper), and -StampDir (M10: the runner passes its --stamp-dir).

label.description: The series label of a table (engine.variant).

bench_args.description: Extra PhysicsTestBench switches for this target only (e.g. an -ini: or -ExecCmds variant of one engine; M8 review: forward-compatible for M9 / M11). No key may repeat one of the matrix's bench_args or --bench-arg (the bench would read only the first occurrence, so the position never decides), nor be a runner switch (see bench_args). The label must tell the target apart: tables group by label.

Extra PhysicsTestBench switches for this scene entry only (M9: e.g. -StatesEvery=1 for the behaviour scenes, -StatesEvery=100 for a 1000-body pile in the same matrix). Same rules as bench_args: no key may repeat one of the matrix's, the target's or --bench-arg switches of the same cell, nor be a runner or mode switch. Not part of the cell id: two scene entries that differ only here are duplicate cells.

stamps.description: M10 fix round 0: the conformance stamp policy of the runner (R9, 02 12.4). require: a cell without a valid stamp refuses the session before any process starts; record: every cell runs and its stamp state is recorded in session.json. Default: require for purpose perf, record for determinism and behavior (R9 is about reportable timing; a behaviour matrix's probe targets with physics-changing -ini: overrides may never pass the gates). ptbench run --require-stamps / --skip-unstamped / --allow-unstamped override it.

cv_gate.description: M10 (02 12.5 step 5): after the R blocks, every cell whose CV exceeds threshold_pct gets one more block (those cells only), at most max_extra_blocks times; a cell still above it is noisy. A perf matrix gates by default (2 %, 2 blocks); false turns it off; another purpose gates only when this is an object.

sentinel.description: M10 (02 12.5 step 4): one cell of the matrix (label, profile, scenario, params, T) that runs at the start, after half of the plan and at the end of the session (runs fresh processes per point, never a cell value); a drift of its value above drift_pct (default 2) - or a point without a headline-valid value - flags the whole session.

exclude.description: Cells to leave out: every named field must match (a list means any of; params: every named parameter). E.g. {"backend": "Bullet", "T": [2, 3, 4, 5, 6], "reason": "Bullet runs T = 1 only (02 9.6)"}.
